findings.reason: In lem-nrqm-symmetries-unitary-conjugation-and-commutation-calculus, steps 3.1, 3.2 and 4.1 do not establish their cited claims: 3.1 verifies only scalar first moments, not the vector integral required by F3; 3.2 approximates for the measure of x but also needs Bx; 4.1 confuses D(K_W)=W D(K) with the conjugated A-flow domain W D(A).

lem-nrqm-symmetries-spatial-rotation-action falsely asserts that a generic rotation preserves each individual D(Q_j) and D(P_k); rotations mix these directional domains. Step 2.2 also equates one coordinate condition with all coordinate conditions. State the exact transported directional domains and retain the valid conjugation and Sobolev claims.

The approved inventory reserves “generators/core,” but lem-nrqm-symmetries-rotation-generators-on-schwartz-classes expressly disclaims a graph-norm core property. Supply the approved core claim with its operator domain and graph norm, or identify the exact approved core claim; the current authoring disposition is not a scope change.

Step 4.1 of lem-nrqm-symmetries-rotation-generators-on-schwartz-classes gives an incorrect product-commutator identity: its last term should be C[A,D]B, not CA[D,B]. The later nonzero term uses the former expression, so correct the identity and retain the verified final commutators.

Step 1.2 of pthm-nrqm-symmetries-translation-invariance-and-momentum-conservation uses z=y-a, which does not yield the displayed kernel rho_epsilon(x-z); use z=y+a and V(z-a)=V(z) almost everywhere. State the radial mollifier majorant needed by the cited recovery lemma. Its remark should say “not almost everywhere constant,” not merely “nonconstant.”

The remark in pthm-nrqm-symmetries-rotational-and-parity-invariance calls “generic” bounded potentials noninvariant without defining generic, and says the companion counterexample is smooth and obstructs rotations/parity. The assigned counterexample is the discontinuous indicator of the unit ball, which is rotationally and parity invariant.

Clause (i) of post-nrqm-symmetries-prescribed-external-coupling adopts a frame and particle model from P5 but its deps omit post-nrqm-framework-nonrelativistic-kinematics-and-massive-particle. The mathematical magnetic-operator definition does not supply that physical frame/model premise; add P5 as a physical-assumption prerequisite.

The prescribed pair is defined on spatial classes, yet clause (v) uses a time derivative of A_ext without a time domain; Phi is only L-infinity, so the field codomain also needs an appropriate weak or distributional definition. Clause (vi)'s “regularity class of gauge items” is not defined earlier. Specify the static-field domain/type and the exact gauge-function class in the postulate.

def-nrqm-symmetries-framework-symmetry-groups-and-conservation names G_chi as a candidate action but defers its definition to later gauge items. Define the multiplier exactly before use, including its action on L2, or remove the undefined name while preserving the approved gauge scope.

pthm-nrqm-symmetries-gauge-covariance cites uniqueness only for curves continuous into W2, but proves only pointwise W2 membership for its displayed curve. The stated bounds do not give time continuity of the second spatial derivatives. Prove uniqueness locally for the stated pointwise-W2, L2-differentiable solution class by conservation of the norm of a difference, or add and carry the stronger regularity.

F3 of ex-nrqm-symmetries-parity-selection-rule states the adjoint identity for an unbounded self-adjoint T with only u in D(T) and v in H, where Tv may be undefined. Its actual use is the bounded operator Pi; state that narrower valid fact.

The out-of-batch lem-nrqm-angular-momentum-su2-lift-of-the-rotation-action repeats the false individual-domain equalities in F2. Its proof uses the valid conjugation identities, so the required outside repair is to remove those equalities and state the transported domains.
